name: The Puppeteer
source:
One of my friends said: "The world is rotten ..." - but I'm the one who will not leave it aside. Heaven is above my head, and behind me are black wings. I am the one who decides your fate.

[Translated from [url=https://l4ui.itch.io/the-puppeteer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我的一个朋友说过：“这个世界已经腐烂了…”而我绝不会坐视不理。天堂在我头顶，漆黑的羽翼在我身后。我，就是决定你命运的人。

[译自[url=https://l4ui.itch.io/the-puppeteer]itch.io[/url]]
